title: NVIDIA 发布 新的 开放 模型 到 运行 智能体 在 企业 和 在 PCs
content: NVIDIA 是 leaning 困难 进入 趋势 的 企业 公司 wanting 到 运行 他们的 own 开放 模型 在 他们的 own 数据中心 和 也 trying 到 制作 在-设备,私有 AI 智能体 thing.
original_title: Nvidia launches new open models to run agents in the enterprise and on PCs
original_content: Nvidia is leaning hard into the trend of enterprise companies wanting to run their own open models in their own data centers and also trying to make on-device, private AI agents a thing.

title: Embedded AI evaluators 赢得’t be 简单 解决方案,Hugging 面临’s 政策 chief 表示
content: idea 的 embedded evaluators — 在 哪个 supposedly "neutral" third-party observers 是 placed inside AI 组织 — 有 been popularized 超过 最后 several 月,作为 AI 实验室 grapple 与 rash 的 安全 incidents 那个 有 spurred 担忧 超过 potential harms 的 他们的 技术.
original_title: Embedded AI evaluators won’t be an easy solution, Hugging Face’s policy chief says
original_content: The idea of embedded evaluators — in which supposedly "neutral" third-party observers are placed inside AI organizations — has been popularized over the last several months, as AI labs grapple with a rash of safety incidents that have spurred concerns over the potential harms of their technology.

original_title: Disney Asked Character.AI to Go Bankrupt for a Get-Out-of-Lawsuits Card
original_content: The entertainment giant hopes to get trust and safety tech, among other IP, from a startup whose chatbots dozens of states allege encouraged minors to self-harm and kill their parents.

content: 公司 提供 一些 broad-strokes ideas 为 如何 这个 资金 可能 实际上 be 使用,如此 作为 “large donations 到 传统 nonprofits 或 direct distributions 到 特定 populations.”

title: Disney agrees 到 招聘 majority 的 Character AI’s workforce
content: filing 也 表示 那个 “vast majority” 的 Character.AI employees 谁 是 提供 工作 在 Disney accepted 他们.然而,这个 是 stalking horse bid,如此 another 公司 可以 来 forward 与 higher 提供.
original_title: Disney agrees to hire the majority of Character AI’s workforce
original_content: The filing also says that the “vast majority” of Character.AI employees who were offered jobs at Disney accepted them. However, this is a stalking horse bid, so another company could come forward with a higher offer.
